text:
Anya (Docs): Heads-up — opened PR #6204 to convert dashboard-presets.yaml -> console-schema.json. Main asks: sanity-check the new compact latency+cost widget, update tracehook snippets (Rust/Go/Ruby), and fix the kv-prefetch guide link that CI flagged as 404.
Sam D. (Eng): Can you paste the diff or the snippet for the latency widget? I can run the local preview.
Anya (Docs): Pasted the small widget block below (trimmed):
```json
{
  "widget_type": "latency_cost_pair",
  "title": "P95 latency vs. token cost",
  "latency_buckets": [50,100,250,500],
  "cost_metric": "token_usd",
  "unit": "ms"
}
```
Liam (Platform): FYI older presets used `latencyBuckets` (camelCase) so the migration script needs to map -> `latency_buckets`. Also watch units — some dashboards recorded seconds historically.
Ben (Product): Can we canary this to 10% of playground users first? Want to watch real-world cost deltas.
Anya (Docs): Yes — plan in PR description: rollout: canary=10% for 24h, then 50% if no regression. I'll add instrumentation to track per-route cost.
Sam D. (Eng): Running preview locally now: `./scripts/preview-dashboard --file dist/console-schema.json --env staging` — if anyone wants to mirror. Log output:
```
INFO  preview: rendered 1 widget (latency_cost_pair)
WARN  widget: unit mismatch: found "s" in old preset, coerced to "ms"
```
Anya (Docs): CI link-checker flagged this: https://redwood.ai/docs/kvcache-prefetch -> 404 (doc moved).
doc-bot: link-checker:found-broken-link @Anya (Docs) (reaction :rotating_light:)
Anya (Docs): I'll replace it with /docs/kv-prefetching (new slug) and add redirect rule in netlify config.
Sam D. (Eng): Small nit on the widget — the cost_metric should be `cost_per_1k_tokens` in our telemetry to match unit conversions. Otherwise numbers look off.
Anya (Docs): Good catch. I'll update the field and add a short note in the migration guide about unit scaling.
Anya (Docs): Also updating tracehook examples. New minimal Ruby snippet:```ruby
# tracehook example (ruby)
Redwood::Tracing.install_hook do |ctx, headers|
  ctx[:trace_id] = headers["x-redwood-trace-id"] || SecureRandom.uuid
  ctx
end
```
Liam (Platform): For Go please use context return style so it composes well with middleware:```go
// tracehook example (go)
func TraceHook(ctx context.Context, headers map[string]string) context.Context {
  if tid, ok := headers["x-redwood-trace-id"]; ok {
    return context.WithValue(ctx, "trace_id", tid)
  }
  return ctx
}
```
Ben (Product): Do we have a Rust snippet request too? Ops asked for one for the on-prem package.
Anya (Docs): I'll add a tiny Rust example showing attaching trace id to a request extension; keeping it minimal.
Sam D. (Eng): Preview looks good after cost_per_1k_tokens change, one last nit: the latency histogram bucket labels should be explicit ("<=50ms", "51-100ms" etc.) — helps UX.
Anya (Docs): Will add bucket labels and update the PR. Pushing patch in a few.
Ben (Product): Thanks — please tag #release-war-room before promoting.
Anya (Docs): Tagged. Also updated netlify redirect and pushed patches for link and snippets.
doc-bot: deploy-preview: build succeeded for PR #6204 — staging URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/presets-preview (reaction :white_check_mark:)
Sam D. (Eng): Quick smoke — loaded the staging preview, clicked through widget; values look sane. LGTM aside from one doc line about ms vs s.
Anya (Docs): Fixed the ms vs s sentence. Merging once CI green and canary flag enabled.
Ben (Product): :thumbsup:
Liam (Platform): Thanks everyone — appreciated the quick turnaround.
Anya (Docs): Closing loop: will follow up in docs changelog with before/after screenshots and a short note on tracehook snippet placements.
Sam D. (Eng): Awesome, thanks!
